reviews.title: Good idea, but too many restrictions
reviews.text: I really like the idea of the app, but there are currently serious issues. For example, I opened a project on my vision, pro, continued editing the project on my iPad and then reopened the project on my Vision Pro. From that point onward, my Vision Pro would not allow me to open that project or any other project asking me to upgrade to another trial. It kept saying that I can only open the most recently edited file, which is what I was trying to do. I feel like the use case of editing a floor plan on an iPad and having it seamlessly be openable and viewable in AR on the Vision Pro would be awesome, but the current restrictions for the free tier and the poor implementation of those restrictions make it impossible to use. So close to being great.
